abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Cardivel. Overall, Brostamide improves blood pressure control compared with Cardivel.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Brostamide lowers systolic drop compared with Cardivel. Overall, Brostamide improves blood pressure control compared with Cardivel.
section:
### Additional comparison

Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Riverside Pressure Registry.
